title: Software Quality Assurance, Senior
description:
**Location:** Hybrid - Pune  
**Position Summary:**

At Bentley Systems, our software forms the digital back

bone for the world's most critical infrastructure projects. The integrity of that backbone rests on the quality of our products, and we are looking for a professional who shares that commitment.

We are seeking a meticulous and proactive **Software Quality Analyst** to join our industry-leading ProjectWise team. In this role, you will hold a pivotal position, responsible for validating the functionality, performance, and stability of software used to design and manage everything from nuclear power plants to international airports.

This is an opportunity to move beyond standard testing. You will be a key contributor to the development lifecycle, acting as a crucial advocate for quality and ensuring that our solutions meet the rigorous demands of the engineers who rely on them. If you are a QA professional driven by a sense of ownership and a desire to work on complex, high-impact products, we encourage you to apply.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Partner with Development, Product Management, and other stakeholders to define quality goals, assess risks, and develop comprehensive test strategies, test scenarios, and validation plans for complex features and releases.
* Lead defect management activities by identifying, documenting, prioritizing, and driving resolution of software defects, ensuring timely communication of quality risks and impacts.
* Own validation efforts for new features and releases, performing and guiding regression, smoke, sanity, exploratory, and risk-based testing activities to ensure product quality.
* Champion quality engineering best practices across the software development lifecycle, driving continuous improvements in processes, testing approaches, and release readiness.
* Analyze quality metrics, test results, and product trends, providing actionable insights and quality recommendations to engineering and product leadership.
* Drive adoption of emerging QA technologies, AI-assisted testing practices, and quality engineering tools, while mentoring team members and sharing best practices across teams.
* Own the setup, maintenance, and troubleshooting of complex test environments, ensuring they accurately represent customer deployments and support effective testing.
* Define and drive the test automation strategy, identify opportunities for AI-assisted and automated testing, and lead initiatives to improve test coverage, reliability, efficiency, and overall product quality.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in a STEM engineering discipline (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics).
* 8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, including ownership of complex testing initiatives and release validation.
* Deep understanding of QA principles, methodologies, and risk-based testing approaches across the software development lifecycle.
* Strong quality ownership mindset, with a proven ability to identify quality risks early, drive resolution, and influence quality outcomes across teams.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to define test strategies, test plans, and test scenarios for complex features, even when requirements are evolving, incomplete, or ambiguous.
* Advanced technical knowledge of test environment architecture, configuration, troubleshooting, and environment readiness management.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to improve test design, quality analysis, productivity, and testing effectiveness.
* Experience working with test automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and quality engineering practices, with the ability to identify automation opportunities and guide adoption.
* Experience mentoring QA engineers, promoting testing best practices, and helping drive a culture of quality within engineering teams.
* Ability to analyze quality trends, define quality metrics, and provide data-driven recommendations to support release readiness decisions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

This is a Hybrid role.  

**What We Offer:**

* Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
* An attractive salary and benefits package.
* Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
* Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
* A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
* Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

**Who We Are:**

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

• Improve QA processes through automation and AI-enabled testing.

• Reduce release timelines and improve deployment frequency through optimized QA validation and regression processes.

• Drive continuous improvements in automation coverage, pipeline health, defect leakage, and release readiness.
